thread:
maria: Heads up — multiple customers reporting console usage metrics delayed by ~6 hours for some tenants. Started ~02:00 UTC. Affected: tenant-123, tenant-987. Customers see empty hourly rollups and "No data" in the usage chart. Escalating to eng. :warning:

jon: Thanks — can you paste a sample tenant id + any error from the analytics pipeline? Is this only rollups or raw events missing too?

maria: tenant-123 sample. Raw events look intact in raw_events for a bit, but rollups job is failing intermittently. Error message from backfill: `ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "rollups_pkey"`

dave: Hmm that usually means a partial retry created overlapping batches. Are we seeing consumer lag on the CDC topic?

jon: Pulled logs from etl-worker-3 around 02:10 UTC. Consumer group lag spiked then. Short log snippet:

```

2026-09-12T02:09:58Z etl-worker-3 [WARN] kafka-consumer group=usage-cdc lag=124388
2026-09-12T02:10:02Z etl-worker-3 [ERROR] rollups.commit failed: pq: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "rollups_pkey" (event_id=evt_8b3f)
2026-09-12T02:10:05Z etl-worker-3 [INFO] retrying batch with dedupe=true
```

jon: Looks like WAL archiver lag + a retry led to duplicate events landing in the rollups pipeline.

sara: Paging infra — kafka partition consumers show high lag (group usage-cdc). Quick mitigation: restart etl-worker-3 to clear stuck offsets and then run dedupe backfill on affected tenants. I'm going to restart the worker now (doing controlled restart). :eyes:

usage-bot: Alert: ETL job rollups.failed count=12 at 2026-09-12T02:14:02Z

maria: For customer communications — can we provide repro steps + ETA for fix? Also need a patch plan so we don't create more duplicates during re-ingest.

dave: Short-term mitigation commands (prod):

```
redwoodctl feature-toggle set realtime_fallback true --tenant=tenant-123
kubectl rollout restart deploy/etl-worker-3 -n prod
scripts/run_backfill.sh --tenant tenant-123 --dedupe --parallel=2
```

dave: realtime_fallback will make the console read raw_events while we rebuild rollups so charts show something.

jon: Repro steps to include in the ticket:
1) Send two identical usage events for same event_id within 1s (simulate producer retry).
2) Force a partial backfill run by killing worker mid-batch so it retries the same batch.
3) Observe `duplicate key value` in rollups logs.

jon: SQL to find duplicates for a tenant (quick):

```
SELECT event_id, count(*) FROM raw_events WHERE tenant_id='tenant-123' GROUP BY event_id HAVING count(*) > 1;
```

jon: To clean up (example; be careful):

```
WITH dups AS (
  SELECT id FROM raw_events WHERE tenant_id='tenant-123' AND event_id='evt_8b3f' ORDER BY created_at DESC OFFSET 1
)
DELETE FROM raw_events WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM dups);
```

sara: After restart: consumer lag dropped from 124k -> 300 within 90s. etl-worker-3 back to Ready. Starting controlled backfill for tenant-123 now. Monitoring in Console > Observability > ETL.

maria: ETA to restore rollups for tenant-123? Customers asking for an update.

dave: Backfill queued, estimate ~25 min for tenant-123 at current parallelism. Will update if it exceeds 45m.

jon: Root cause action items:
- add stricter dedupe option by default on backfill runs (data-eng)
- add alert for kafka consumer-group lag > 50k (sre)
- improve partial-retry semantics to avoid double-write to rollups (backend)

maria: I'll update the support tickets with workaround (realtime_fallback) and ETA. Also adding follow-up to postmortem if duplicates visible after backfill.

sara: Runbook ref: /runbooks/etl-backfill (link shared in thread). If anyone sees other tenants with similar symptoms, add them to this thread.

maria: Thanks team — will confirm when customers see data restored. :thumbsup:
